findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Network request sinks in jsonschema
 * @description Identifies calls to requests or urllib that may lead to SSRF or local file disclosure via URI schemes
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/network-request-sinks
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-918
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.Concepts

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember(["get", "post", "put", "delete", "request", " head", "Session"]).getACall()
  or
  call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember(["urlopen", "Request", "urlretrieve"]).getACall()
  or
  call instanceof Http::Client::Request
select call, "Network request call in " + call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() + " at line " + call.getLocation().getStartLine().toString()
findings.hypothesis: Identify HTTP/URI request sinks (requests, urllib.request.urlopen) in jsonschema such as RefResolver remote reference resolution leading to SSRF or local file read.

/**
 * @name Inspect network request functions and callers in validators.py
 * @description Examine functions making network requests and where they are called or referenced
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/inspect-ssrf-validators
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-918
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from Function func, DataFlow::CallCfgNode netCall
where
  (
    netCall = API::moduleImport("requests").getMember(["get", "post", "request", "Session"]).getACall() or
    netCall = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember(["urlopen", "Request", "urlretrieve"]).getACall()
  ) and
  netCall.getScope() = func
select netCall,
  "Function '" + func.getName() + "' (lines " + func.getLocation().getStartLine().toString() + "-" +
    func.getLocation().getEndLine().toString() + ") makes network call with arg0: " +
    netCall.getArg(0).asExpr().toString()
findings.hypothesis: Inspect the functions making HTTP requests in jsonschema/validators.py and check what URL arguments are passed to them.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Remote retrieve usage and URI handling
 * @description Check how _warn_for_remote_retrieve and resolve_remote are invoked and whether they are default behaviors in validators
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/remote-retrieve-usage
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-918
 *        external/cwe/cwe-73
 */

import python

from AstNode n
where
  n.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() = "jsonschema/validators.py" and
  (
    exists(Name name | name = n and name.getId() in ["_warn_for_remote_retrieve", "RefResolver", "_REMOTE_WARNING", "urlopen", "Registry"]) or
    exists(Attribute attr | attr = n and attr.getName() in ["resolve_remote", "resolve_from_url", "handlers"])
  )
select n, n.toString() + " in scope " + n.getScope().toString() + " at line " + n.getLocation().getStartLine().toString()
findings.hypothesis: Determine if remote/file URI resolution via urlopen or requests is enabled by default in jsonschema validators or RefResolver, allowing SSRF or local file inclusion via $ref

/**
 * @name Regular expression compilation with untrusted pattern
 * @description Compiling regular expressions from schema or format checking
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/regex-compilation-check
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-1333
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember(["compile", "search", "match", "fullmatch"]).getACall()
  and not call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() = "noxfile.py"
select call, "Regex call in " + call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() + " at line " + call.getLocation().getStartLine().toString()
findings.hypothesis: Identify regular expression operations in jsonschema that could lead to ReDoS (CWE-1333) when processing untrusted schemas or instances.
